name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
summary: Income support of Rs. 6,000 per year to eligible landholding farmer families, paid in three equal instalments of Rs. 2,000 every four months.

eligibility_clauses.text: The applicant must be a landholding farmer family with cultivable land.
Institutional landholders and persons holding constitutional posts are excluded.
Income-tax payers are excluded from the scheme.

entitlement_rules.text: Eligible farmer families receive Rs. 2,000 per instalment, three instalments per year (total Rs. 6,000 per year).

appeal_hierarchy.description: Grievance redressal at district agriculture office.
Escalation to the state nodal department.
